name: Toono Masami
source:
[i]"There won't be a next time."[/i]

Chief administrator of the Takasato-gumi. Cunning and ambitious, Toono eagerly awaits his chance to swipe the position of leader out from under his rival Sakaki.

[From the digital manual included with r59230]
